content_sections.heading: Nagaland University Project Associate-I Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the Nagaland University Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download Nagaland University Project Associate-I Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Nagaland University Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization recruiting for?
faq.answer: Nagaland University is recruiting for the post of Project Associate-I. This is a contractual government job opportunity for eligible candidates in Nagaland.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive by Nagaland University is Project Associate-I. There are a total of 2 vacancies available for this position.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Associate-I post in Nagaland University. Interested candidates should check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for Nagaland University Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Project Associate-I recruitment at Nagaland University is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend an interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q5. What are the required qualifications for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a First class M.Sc./M.Tech in Botany/Life Sciences/Biotechnology from a UGC recognized University to be eligible for the Project Associate-I post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Nagaland University Project Associate-I Walk-in Interview 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the walk-in interview date for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Associate-I post at Nagaland University is scheduled for 19 August 2026. Candidates should report on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for Project Associate-I at Nagaland University?
faq.answer: The job type for the Project Associate-I position at Nagaland University is Contractual. This offers a temporary engagement for the duration of the project.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I post at Nagaland University will be based on a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be evaluated on their qualifications and performance.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for Nagaland University Project Associate-I recruitment will be held in Lumami, Nagaland. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue address.
